impact: Confirms a hawkish Fed into December and keeps pressure on long-duration tech and AI names; a 50bp debate would hit rate-sensitive growth stocks hardest.
summary: Minutes of the Oct 27-28 meeting (held at 3.75-4%, 10-2 vote with Cook and Hammack dissenting for a hike) show nearly all participants judged further rate increases would likely be appropriate. A couple said a move larger than 25bp could be considered if inflation data disappoint, and many flagged the AI buildout as a material source of inflation risk. Markets price about 96% odds of a December 8-9 hike.
title: Fed minutes: nearly all officials see further hikes, a couple floated a bigger move
